name: Stateless JWT installation token
description: The stateless installation token: a ghs_-prefixed JWT, written ghs_APPID_JWT, about 520 characters long (varying with its contents) and containing two dots, signed with a GitHub-internal issuer and not for clients to parse or validate. It replaces the opaque form for newly minted tokens as the staged rollout reaches an installation; the APPID segment grammar is not documented, and a ghs_ value without it also matches the provider-recommended regex.

history.note: GitHub announced on 2026-04-24 a staged rollout starting 2026-04-27, and on 2026-05-15 added a temporary per-request header (enabled) to request this form on demand. Rollout completion was stated later, on 2026-10-02 (next entry).

sources.supports: Staged rollout starting 2026-04-27; token format changes to ghs_APPID_JWT.
Header value enabled returns a stateless (JWT-format) token regardless of rollout position; a stateless token is a ghs_-prefixed JWT with two dots.
sources.locator: What is the header?; How to use it

history.note: GitHub stated on 2026-10-02 that the staged rollout is complete and that by default all newly minted installation tokens are now stateless, about 520 characters instead of 40; the temporary header is to be deprecated on 2026-11-30, after which all eligible apps always receive this form. The 2026-10-02 date is the date of the provider's statement, not necessarily of the last installation reached. This closes the rollout-completion question in the contract.

sources.supports: Rollout complete; default for all newly minted installation tokens is ghs_APPID_JWT; header deprecated 2026-11-30.
